units.text: Last week, I sat down to answer one email. Just one.
Watched half a video essay about the rise and fall of fax machines
Added a spatula to my online cart
And totally forgot to reply to the email.
If your brain has a habit of wandering, bouncing, or straight-up ditching you
when you need it most, you‟re not alone. Focus isn‟t about willpower—it‟s about
creating a space that works with your brain, not against it.
This is a space where you can quiet the noise, take back your time, and train
your focus without guilt or pressure.
What does “focus” feel like to me—
and what usually gets in the way?
Some pages will help you get clear. Others will help you reset. All of them are
here to support the version of you that wants to feel more present, intentional,
and in control of your time.
